title: Perfect Coding Prompts
description: Prompt pack for debugging, architecture, and cleaner code output.
seoDescription: Use coding prompts to debug faster and generate production-ready code.

prompts.title: Bug Diagnosis
prompts.description: Find root cause of runtime errors.
prompts.text: Diagnose this error and provide root cause, fix steps, and corrected code: [error + code].

prompts.title: Refactor Prompt
prompts.text: Refactor this function for clarity and performance, and explain tradeoffs: [code].

prompts.title: API Design
prompts.text: Design REST API endpoints for [feature], including request/response schema and validation rules.

prompts.title: Test Case Generator
prompts.text: Generate comprehensive test cases (including edge cases) for this function: [function].

prompts.title: PR Review Assistant
prompts.description: Review pull requests with risk insights.
prompts.text: Review this pull request diff and list bugs, regressions, performance risks, and missing tests.

body:
Prompt pack for debugging, architecture, and cleaner code output.

Bug Diagnosis

Find root cause of runtime errors.

Diagnose this error and provide root cause, fix steps, and corrected code: [error + code].

Refactor Prompt

Improve readability and maintainability.

Refactor this function for clarity and performance, and explain tradeoffs: [code].

API Design

Design scalable API structures.

Design REST API endpoints for [feature], including request/response schema and validation rules.

Test Case Generator

Create unit and edge-case tests.

Generate comprehensive test cases (including edge cases) for this function: [function].

PR Review Assistant

Review pull requests with risk insights.

Review this pull request diff and list bugs, regressions, performance risks, and missing tests.
